text.p: Tropical Storm Abel is weakening and will probably be downgraded to a depression just south of Hainan China this period. Moisture from the storm will track through Hainan producing heavy rain and possible flooding.
Tropical Depression 31W will intensify to a tropical storm while moving through the Mariana Islands producing gusty winds and locally heavy rain squalls.

Tropical depression 32w should become an increasing risk to shipping as it strengthens and moves towards Luzon during today and Tuesday. Top winds are currently 35 mph but they should reach 55-60 mph in 24 hours and 75-80 mph in 48 hours. It is expected to reach northeast Luzon as a weak typhoon in about 60 hours. Luzon can expect to see heavy rains developing later this period. This should cause flooding and may cause mudslides.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
